syllabus.title: Agriculture Technology 7–10 Syllabus (2024)
syllabus.outcome_code_family: AGT5 adjusted for Year 8 under AGT4-ADJ-01

stage_adjustment.statement: in Stage 4 teachers may adjust the Stage 5 outcomes as appropriate to the needs of students in Years 7 and 8

outcomes.statement: applies production processes and safe work practices in agricultural contexts
explains factors that influence animal and plant selection, growth and development in agricultural enterprises and systems
explains industry practices in agricultural enterprises and systems
analyses relationships between agricultural production, sustainability and consumers
investigates and assesses the influence of innovation and management practices on agricultural enterprises and systems
selects and justifies the use of technologies and processes in agricultural production and systems
communicates ideas and concepts in agricultural technology contexts

whole_course_requirements.scope: 100-hour elective only; not claimed as complete within this 50-period unit
requirements: at least 2 enterprises drawing on appropriate focus areas
one intensive or one extensive enterprise
one plant enterprise and one animal enterprise

expected_structure.title: The Value of Agriculture and Food Security
Introduction to Beef Cattle and Breeds
Paddock to Plate — Technology, Nutrition and Choice
Australian Poultry Industry — Farm to Plate

learning_package_state.required_shape: three sections per module; ten MCQs and one higher-order long response per section
learning_package_state.current_shape: three sections and ten MCQs per section are present; the inherited course currently retains two written responses per section
learning_package_state.status: scoped realignment preserves current learning content; consolidation to one response and a current presentation set remain separate rework before full initial-build acceptance

visual_coverage.basis: Thirty-three section-matched theory visuals and twelve folio evidence visuals serve the eleven-module, twenty-week unit. The separate hero is not counted.
